title: Project entity: per-file editor data (curve colours, waves, undo journal) in a per-project folder (.scp.json) -- service class + API first

decisions.text: Core is a server-side service ProjectStore in MindWaveCore/server/project-store.ts (host-level infrastructure, not Gnaural-specific), following the GnauralEditorStore archetype: interface + Impl + createProjectStore factory, ProjectStoreError extends Error {status} + mapProjectStoreError, singleton wired in server.ts next to archiveStore/gnauralEditorStore. UI client lives with its consumers: GnauralCore/ui/project-api.ts + composables/use-project.ts, modelled on audio-api.ts.

Project identity: normalized absolute source path -> deterministic folder name <slug>-<hash8>. slug = sanitized basename without extension (Windows-forbidden chars -> _, ~40 chars cap); hash8 = first 8 hex of sha1(resolve(path).toLowerCase()) -- same normalization as withFileLock. project.scp.json stores source.path + fingerprint (size, mtime) for status checks and re-link. No global index: listing = scan of projects/*/project.scp.json.

Project folder layout: <userDataRoot>/projects/<slug>-<hash8>/ containing project.scp.json (the main file, text, pretty JSON, req 4), undo.json (text, separate file because it is large and written often), cache/ (the ONLY place where binary files are allowed; reqs 5-6). Main file name is fixed; human readability is carried by the folder name and source.path, which survives source renames.

project.scp.json schema: { schemaVersion: 1, kind: 'SoundCoreProject', source, createdAt, updatedAt, sections: { <name>: opaque JSON } }. The core does not know section contents -- each section is owned by its subsystem (req 2); unknown sections are preserved on rewrite (forward compatibility). Writes are atomic (tmp+rename); reads are tolerant: a corrupt file is renamed to project.scp.json.broken-<ts>, store restarts empty, incident is logged -- never silently lost.

API-first (req 7). Phase 1 delivers the full core interface: openProject (find-or-create + folder provisioning), getProject, listProjects (scan + source status ok|moved|missing), getSection/putSection (atomic, coalesced), getUndoJournal/putUndoJournal (limits), cacheFilePath/readCacheFile/writeCacheFile/clearCache (bin allowed), deleteProject, relinkProject, exportProject/importProject. On top: REST /api/projects* with the {error} envelope, Project* types in SharedPasCore/ts/protocol.ts, UI client project-api.ts, composable use-project.ts (reactive sections: debounce, flush on file switch). Server subsystems call ProjectStore directly (DI of the singleton).

User data folder: key user_data_root in the SQLite app_settings table, default <serverDir>/var/userdata (inside the already-gitignored var/); projects under <root>/projects/. Editable in editor settings (req 3), validated like presetsRoot (directory must exist); changing the folder migrates projects (PR3.2). Q1 for the owner: default var/userdata or Documents\MindWave?

Write discipline: client debounces ~500ms per section + immediate flush on file switch/unload; server keeps a per-project sequential write queue (withFileLock analogue). No cross-tab conflict detection: last-write-wins per section (sections are small and independent -- risk R2, accepted).

Undo journal (req 1): GTrackSchedule snapshots are already JSON-serializable (signature() = JSON.stringify), so the journal persists to undo.json with limits (~50 entries and/or ~5 MB), deferred writes (on activity pause), restore on file open. The core ships only the get/put transport (PR1.3); GTrackModel integration is PR2.2.

Project cache (reqs 5-6): new per-file caches go to the project's cache/ folder, binary allowed, invalidation by source fingerprint (size+mtime, as in the existing manifest keys). First real consumer: waveform peaks cache (PR6.1; today peaks are recomputed on every open). The existing central WAV render cache moves in a dedicated step PR6.2 AFTER the core, to keep req 7 the priority; ordering to be confirmed (Q4).

Import/export without zip dependencies (none exist in the workspace): export = a single text bundle <slug>.scpexport.json (schemaVersion + project.scp.json + undo.json; cache/ excluded by default, base64 when includeCache). One portable file, stays text (req 5). Import: schema validation, conflict with an existing project -> 409 + explicit choice, re-link to the local source path. Q3: this bundle vs zip.

Migration of existing per-file localStorage keys (mindwave-gtrack-lanes, mindwave-gtrack-lane-spectrum, mindwave-gtrack-mix-excluded) into project sections, one-time on first open of the file; the localStorage copy is NOT deleted in this plan (transition safety net, risk R5). Data living inside .gnaural itself (voice colour/hidden/muted) is NOT duplicated by the project; moving it out is Q2 (recommendation: keep as is for now -- today changing a colour rewrites the source file, and changing that is a separate owner decision).

Tests and verification: project-store.test.ts co-located, bun:test, mkdtemp fixture (modelled on audio-cache-manifest.test.ts). There is no CI -- each step's verify is run by hand (plan section 6); prefer driving the real app over a green typecheck.

log.text: Plan + ledger created for the Project entity (owner req. 2026-07-15): per-file editor data -- curve colours, waves, undo journal -- moves into a per-project folder under a configurable user-data root; main file project.scp.json, everything text except bin under cache/; cache data lives in the project folder too. Survey found today's state scattered: voice colours are written INTO the .gnaural, lanes/solo live in per-file localStorage keys, undo and zoom are memory-only and lost on reload, caches are central under server/tmp. Full function set planned (open/sections/undo/cache/list/relink/delete/import/export/settings), with the service class + API first (PR-D5, Phase 1). Decisions PR-D1..D12 proposed; five owner questions (default data folder, fate of in-file voice colours, export format, render-cache move, per-file waveform colours) queued at the PR0.2 PAUSE.
